title: Studio's "Add region" writes region_N, a name the save door refuses on every template but dashboard; and a page that names no template still stacks such a region (objectstack#23610 Q2 A follow-up)
body:
Filing gate ①: a product defect with a named producer, from the os-dev report on objectui#12476 (PR #12901, out-of-scope finding, class c). Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.

## What

Since `@objectstack/spec` `18.0.0-next.2` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23610, maintainer ruling Q2 A), a `kind: full` page's region must be named for a slot its template places (`PAGE_TEMPLATE_SLOTS`); `checkPageRegionPlacement` (`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts:1602`) judges a page with no `template` as `default` (`:1607`) and refuses any other name at `os validate` and at the metadata save door (422 `INVALID_METADATA`). Two objectui positions still produce or draw such a region:

1. **Studio writes it.** `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/PageBlockCanvas.tsx` `addRegion` (`:401` on `main` `d2b21a1`) appends `{ name: region_N, components: [] }` whatever the page's template is. On `default`, `header-sidebar-main`, `three-column` or no template, that name is not a slot, so the draft Studio's own "Add region" button writes is refused when the author saves it. Only `dashboard` places it (an open grid cell).
2. **The template-less renderer path still stacks it.** objectui#12476 (PR #12901) makes a slotted template refuse an unplaced region on screen instead of stacking it under `main`, and keeps the `pageType` dispatch (a page that names no template) as it was: `RegionLayout` without a template still stacks a region with no slot name under `main`. The spec judges that same page as `default` and refuses the region. PageView and PagePreview spread the raw stored row with no parse, so such a row reaches this path.

**reach:** named real producer: Studio's page designer "Add region" (`PageBlockCanvas.tsx:401`), on any page whose template is not `dashboard`. The save refusal is the spec's own (`page.zod.ts:1607`, `:1625`); not measured in a browser.

## Expected

- Studio's "Add region" offers only a slot the page's template has not filled (or, on `dashboard`, a grid cell name), so it never writes a name the save door refuses.
- The template-less path treats a `kind: full` page as the spec does, as `default`, so a region it does not place is refused on screen exactly as on a `default` page, with the record page and other app-shell pages built in code checked first (their regions are `main` and `aside` only, per the #12476 caller sweep).

**Reader who acts:** objectui triage, then `domain:ui`. The first landings are `PageBlockCanvas.tsx` (`addRegion`) and `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx` (`RegionLayout` without a template). Grading note: the filing gate's grading rule names "a designer systematically writes metadata the protocol refuses" as a consumer follow-up that breaks users.

**Dedupe** (open and closed): objectui issues searched for "Studio page designer Add region writes region_N name refused at save unplaced region template slots": 2 hits, objectui#12476 (this card's parent work, open) and objectui#1495 (closed, slotted record-page slot blocks, a different surface). Neither names `addRegion` or the template-less path.

Dedupe words: addRegion region_N, PageBlockCanvas add region refused, unplaced region template-less page, checkPageRegionPlacement default template.
